videos.title: Google Antigravity Plugin Suite — Complete Tour
videos.summary: Practical tour of where to click across WV Antigravity Overview, WV Clawy 🐻, Action Items, WV Skills & Personal Skills, TokenEconomics, and WV Preview.
videos.tryPrompt: /daily-brief Walk me through my workspace Overview, open Action Items, Personal Skills, and TokenEconomics health.

videos.title: Getting Started in 60 Seconds & Using Turbo Mode
videos.summary: Step-by-step guide to pasting the 1-line install command, using ⚡ Turbo during setup vs. 🔒 Default for daily work, and setting your role and writing voice.
videos.tryPrompt: /memory Check my role profile, writing voice, and personal memory setup and confirm Default review safety best practices.

videos.title: Using 1-Click Skills, Personal Skills & Visual Previews (Dashboards & Slides)
videos.summary: How to run 40 ready-made skills in WV Skills, create your own Personal Skills (+ New Skill), and customize interactive Dashboards & 16:9 Slide Decks in WV Preview.
videos.tryPrompt: /slides Create a crisp 5-slide executive readiness briefing deck with speaker notes and open the rendered visual preview in the Side Pane.

videos.title: Working Faster with Orchestrator & Managing TokenEconomics
videos.summary: How to click ⚡ Orchestrator on multi-step tasks, prep big meetings in 60s with /swarm-prep, and track your monthly plan in TokenEconomics.
videos.tryPrompt: /orchestrator-guide Show me how to combine Orchestrator (Argon/Neon + Hydrogen) with deterministic Workflows to maximize quality and stretch my pooled quota.

videos.title: How to Use Clawy — Multi-Agent Command Center & Gemini Live Voice
videos.summary: How to open WV Clawy 🐻, see which parallel chats Need You, click ↗ Pop Out for side-by-side split view, connect Kore Gemini Live voice, and track Goals.
videos.tryPrompt: /wv-coordinator Summarize my active agent conversations and show any items waiting on me.
